title: Algebraic moduli stacks and smooth atlases
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Use categories fibred in groupoids, functors over $\mathit{Sch}/S$, their 2-fibre products, etale stack descent, and algebraic-space presentations of scheme 2-base changes as in [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids], with algebraic spaces as in [def-trf-algebraic-space]. A map from an algebraic space $Z$ to a scheme $T$ is smooth if its composite with every representable etale scheme chart of $Z$ is smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. A smooth surjective scheme atlas of $\mathcal F$ is a functor $h_U\to\mathcal F$ such that for every $h_T\to\mathcal F$ the 2-fibre product is equivalent over $T$ to an algebraic space $Z$, and its specified projection $Z\to T$ is smooth and surjective. Call $\mathcal F$ an algebraic stack if it is an etale stack, its diagonal is representable by algebraic spaces, and it admits such an atlas. Call it smooth over $S$ if it has a smooth surjective scheme atlas $U\to\mathcal F$ with smooth structural morphism $U\to S$. These predicates choose no atlas or presentation.
